summary: Imagine Thailand is an organizer-announced two-night music and arts festival at Lanna Resort, Chiang Mai, from 30 December 2026 through 1 January 2027. The official site describes live and electronic music, visual and performance art, workshops, and a New Year countdown. This is a named festival, distinct from the separate CAD countdown and from ordinary hotel fireworks parties. The Thailand edition is presented as inaugural; its ticket button currently leads to a 404 page.
whyGo: Attend a multi-night music and arts gathering rather than a single countdown show.
Camping is included according to the organizer, with drinking water, showers and restrooms at designated areas.
bestFor: Music and arts fans open to an inaugural festival with an evolving programme.
Travellers able to stay outside central Chiang Mai and plan late-night transport.
skipIf: You need a confirmed ticket price, artist lineup, daily timetable or accessible facilities before deciding.
You prefer a walkable city-centre New Year or cannot camp and have not arranged nearby accommodation.
duration: Two nights across 30 December–1 January; allow three calendar days including arrival and departure. Exact gate opening and performance hours are unpublished.
cost: Ticket price could not be verified: the official site says early-bird tickets are available, but its ticket link returned 404 during this check. Camping is advertised as included. Budget separately for food, equipment if needed, and transport; no verified shuttle fare or tent-hire details were found.
hours: Officially advertised for 30 December 2026 to 1 January 2027. Music is described as running on 30–31 December through the New Year countdown; daily gate times and a detailed schedule are not published.
bestTime: Plan to reach the venue in daylight on 30 December as a practical preference, and check the organizer’s updates for gate and shuttle times before travel.
gettingThere: Lanna Resort is in Ban Pong, Hang Dong District. The organizer estimates about 40 minutes by road from Chiang Mai International Airport and says shuttle service will run to and from the venue, with De Charme Hotel as the main city pickup/drop-off point. Shuttle times are still pending. Ride-hailing and rental cars are alternatives mentioned by the organizer; agree the return plan before leaving the city.
booking: The official homepage advertises early-bird tickets, but the linked product page returned 404 during research. Do not treat the button as a functioning booking route; check the official site or contact the organizer for a working link, price, admission dates and refund terms before paying.
accessibility: The checked organizer pages do not describe step-free paths, accessible toilets, viewing areas or shuttle accessibility. Ask the organizer directly about the resort’s outdoor terrain and specific access needs before booking.
practicalTips: Camping is included; the organizer lists water, showers and restrooms, but does not confirm tent or bedding provision.
The organizer names De Charme Hotel as the shuttle stop but has not posted the timetable; verify whether space and fares require advance reservation.
Bring comfortable outdoor footwear and a warm layer for late evenings, and keep the return journey flexible until shuttle details are published.
decemberNotes: This is the actual 2026–27 Imagine Thailand edition advertised for 30 December through 1 January. The organizer calls it the first Thailand edition. CAD’s separately ticketed Mae On countdown is a different event; a countdown or fireworks listing alone should not be described as this music festival.
uncertainties: Ticket price and a working ticket-sales page are unresolved; the official early-bird button led to a 404 page.
Artist lineup, gate hours, daily timetable, shuttle times/fares, tent hire and refund conditions are not confirmed on the checked official pages.
No event-specific accessibility information was published in the checked guidance.
